protocol.startup: Process launch under Playwright to visible Welcome in DOM. New disposable profile, then same-profile relaunch. OS caches untouched.
protocol.ram: Summed RSS from macOS ps, including app descendants and profile-marked helpers. Shared pages may be counted in multiple processes.
protocol.cpu: Process CPU-time deltas; 100% = one logical CPU. Subprocesses that exit between samples can be missed.
protocol.typing: Chromium keydown to second requestAnimationFrame, 30 verified characters per scenario. Presentation/compositor latency is not measured.
protocol.fixtures: 10 text files of 650 lines each, four C programs, and 40 subfolders with 25 files each. Six expanded on demand. Each subsequent tab cycle opens and closes three files.
